statement: The IAFD-905 (FF-AR54-APPIII-P1D-CHAR) field set in FORM_FIELDS_C13_v2.csv has only 5 rows, all from the substituted para 9 (S.R.O. 17(E)/1993 item 39(a)). Each row says it supersedes 'C12 FORM_FIELDS rows of this family', which are all 16 rows. The other C12 rows of the form are dropped instead of carried with a label. The register gives required_fields as '5 printed elements', which overstates the official coverage of IAFD-905.
evidence: grep FF-AR54-APPIII-P1D-CHAR: 5 rows in v2 against 16 in C12 FORM_FIELDS.csv. v2 column supersedes_c12_rows. FORM_REGISTER_C13 required_fields / source_fidelity_c13 = 'OFFICIAL_AMENDING_TEXT_TRANSCRIBED; REST_MML_ONLY_UNVERIFIED'. 1954 Gazette p.72 runs from Appendix I Form II straight to Appendix III Part II, so no Part I base text is held.
requested_action: Limit supersession to the para 9 rows. Carry the other C12 rows as CARRIED_FROM_C12: MML_ONLY_UNVERIFIED. Correct required_fields. Keep R04 deferred for this family until the official Appendix III Part I text is acquired.
